title:
Epic used to add or remove correlated features from an {@link ReliabilityAsset asset}.

Expected Payload:
- `gridsToReload`: Array of {@link UiSdlDataGrid grid ids} to reload after the operation.
  The following actions are triggered on these grids:
  - {@link UiSdlBaseDataGrid#toggleSelectAllAction}: Unselects all rows.
  - {@link UiSdlDataRedux#requestDataAction}: Fetches the latest data and updates the grid.
- `add`: Boolean indicating whether to add the correlated features. If false, the correlated features are removed.
  Based on this value, the following methods are called:
  - `true`: {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorAssociationHelper#addCorrelatedFeatures}
  - `false`: {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorAssociationHelper#removeCorrelatedFeatures}
- `gridId`: ID of the {@link UiSdlDataGrid} to get the {@link UiSdlDataGrid#selectedItemIds} from.
- `componentId`: ID of the {@link UiSdlModal} triggering the action. This field is automatically included when
  the action is triggered from a modal.
name: SensorAssociationAddRemoveCorrelatedFeaturesEpic
